name: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
description: Calculates the total OEE factoring in Availability, Performance, and Quality.
example: What is the OEE for Machine 14 on Monday?

name: Excess Give Away (EGA)
description: Measures material wasted by filling beyond the theoretical pack weight.
example: Show me the EGA percentage for line 2 last week.

name: Quality Percentage
description: Percentage of good bags out of total bags produced, excluding failed/overlimit.
example: What was the quality rate across all machines yesterday?

name: Machine Availability
description: Percentage of scheduled time the machine was actively running without downtime.
example: Which machine had the lowest availability on May 28th?

name: Production Performance
description: Calculates actual production speed versus the target theoretical speed.
example: Show me the performance metrics for the morning shift.

name: GSM Consumption
description: Tracks total packaging material consumption calculated from start and end roll weights.
example: What is the total GSM consumption for ITC?

name: Mean Time To Repair (MTTR)
description: Average time taken to resolve machine errors (jam, splice, print check, etc).
example: What is the MTTR for Machine A?

name: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
example: Which machine has the best MTBF?

name: Total Wastage
description: Sum of all recorded physical wastage in kilograms.
example: How much total wastage was recorded at Plant 1?
